verdict.rationale: Using CPU instruction sets for faster inference is a fair performance axis for a local LLM runner like LM Studio. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX, or any CPU instruction-set optimization. The llama.cpp backend mention (lm-studio-docs-29) is an underlying engine reference, not documented support for this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
